## Checklist

- [ ] `screensavers/<id>/` with `saver.json` (`name`, `blurb`, `author`, `license`), `index.html`, `preview.jpg`
- [ ] `author` is how I want to be credited (optional `authorUrl`); `credits` lists anything I didn't make
- [ ] `python3 -I scripts/validate.py` runs clean; `index.json` and the README gallery are committed as generated
- [ ] No network, no audio, no external URLs; handles resize and prefers-reduced-motion; pauses while hidden
- [ ] Ran for an hour in a tab without memory growth; the first frame is a strong composition
- [ ] It's my own work (or credited), not a company's branding
